title: Improve spinner in bash mode to make it more clear the bash command is running
body: **Bug Description** when I type "!" and then a bash command it seems like claude is still trying to figure out what to do instead of just running the bash command **Environment Info** - Platform: macos - Terminal: WarpTerminal - Version: 0.2.41 - Feedback ID: f302cbda-69fd-486c-94e8-b43445b155df
